column1: # af3lis smoke test -- 2 baits x 6 preys = 12 folds.

# GPU hours. Every accession below is reviewed (sp|) and its length was

#                   array, bridge grouping across TWO token buckets (256 and
#                   512), packed GPU inference, collect, figures, PDB export,
#                   and the afterany chain.
#   NOT covered  -- the >=4096-token memory tier in the resource ladder. Hitting
#                   it needs a ~1500 aa partner, which is no longer a "small
#                   job"; that branch is covered by
#                   tests/test_pack.py::test_resources_for_ladder instead.
